integrity: The proof is analytic; exact-rational checks supplement it. The two-tap zero-momentum all-mode case is credited as prior art. Distinct method comparisons and uncertainty about unindexed ARMA parameter-design literature are disclosed.
scientific_limitations: Exact arithmetic, linear quadratic targets, strictly positive momentum below one and a stepsize-curvature product strictly between zero and one, isotropic shared real two-tap Gaussian coefficients. Statements concern stationary position laws, not temporal dependence, nonlinear potentials, fully general noise or exact kinetic integration.
title: Two-mode exact Gaussian calibration by two-tap noise in a momentum recurrence
